name: shifra-language
description: RTL-friendly editor for Shifra (Arabic Python 3, .ar/.sf/.شفـ) files: syntax highlighting, live diagnostics, symbols, folding, hover documentation, and one-key running.

shifra.runtime.command.markdownDescription: Command used to run `.ar/.sf/.شفـ` files. When empty, the extension searches for a Shifra/RustPython checkout (the `shifra.runtime.projectDir` setting, `SHIFRA_DIR`, `RUSTPYTHON_DIR`, an open workspace, or the extension's own folder when developing) and uses its built `rustpython` binary — preferring `target/release/shifra` for speed, falling back to `target/debug/shifra`, then `cargo run --release --manifest-path`.

shifra.runtime.projectDir.markdownDescription: Path to the Shifra checkout (must contain a workspace `Cargo.toml`). Leave empty for automatic detection.

shifra.runtime.terminalName.description: Name of the integrated terminal used to run `.ar/.sf/.شفـ` files.

shifra.runtime.captureErrors.description: Capture the script's stderr (via process substitution) to highlight the failing line in the editor. Set to false on non-bash shells.

shifra.rtlEditor.fontFamily.default: JetBrains Mono, Thmanyah Sans Term, monospace
shifra.rtlEditor.fontFamily.description: Font family used by the Shifra RTL editor. Must be a monospace family so Arabic stays grid-aligned; pair with the shipped Thmanyah Sans Term (editors/fonts) for correct joined glyphs.

shifra.rtlEditor.fontSize.description: Font size used by the Shifra RTL editor.

shifra.rtlEditor.tabSize.description: Visual width of indentation tabs in the Shifra RTL editor.

shifra.rtlEditor.lineSpacing.description: Line height multiplier in the Shifra RTL editor. Controls line, caret, and line-number height together.
